answer: Anchor every new identity to reputation earned elsewhere. First, a newcomer registers by linking an external account, a code host with six months of history, which signs the registration. Second, that outside account can sponsor only one PoA identity, and the link stays public. Third, one proven fraud burns the link forever. Buying 1,000 aged accounts with real history costs about $15 each, $15,000 for a farm, while one honest agent pays nothing. Like a tundra crossing, one trail proves one traveller; a lagoon holds only so many boats, and an orchard bears fruit from one root per tree.
